function.name: calculate_electrostatic_potential
function.description: Calculate the electrostatic potential between two charged bodies using the principle of Coulomb's Law.

charge1.description: The quantity of charge on the first body. This is a float type value.

charge2.description: The quantity of charge on the second body. This is a float type value.

distance.description: The distance between the two bodies. This is a float type value.

constant.description: The value of the electrostatic constant. Default is 898755178.73 This is a float type value.

function.name: calculate_neuronal_activity
function.description: Calculate the neuronal activity (rate of firing) based on a given input synaptic rate, weight of inputs, and decay rate. Higher input or weight increases firing rate and higher decay rate decreases it.

input_synaptic_rate.description: The synaptic input rate, usually represented as number of inputs per second.

weight.description: The weight of the input, denoting its influence on the neuron's state. Default is 1.0. This is a float type value.

decay_rate.description: The rate at which the neuron's potential decays in the absence of inputs. This is a float type value.

function.name: calculate_displacement
function.description: Calculates the displacement of an object in motion given initial velocity, time, and acceleration.

initial_velocity.description: The initial velocity of the object in m/s. This is a float type value.

time.description: The time in seconds that the object has been in motion.

acceleration.description: The acceleration of the object in m/s^2. This is a float type value.

function.name: grocery_store_find_best
function.description: Find the closest high-rated grocery stores based on certain product availability.

my_location.description: The current location of the user.

rating.description: The minimum required store rating. Default is 0.0. This is a float type value.
